checks.lead: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (27 January 1756 – 5 December 1791) was a Salzburger classical composer and musician. He completed more than 800 works in his life—including outstanding examples of most of the genres of his time: symphonies, concertos, chamber music, opera and choral music. He is regarded as one of the greatest composers in the history of Western music.
